implementation_summary: Pinned @941design/marmot, marmot-engine, nostr-events 0.2.0-alpha.0 and nostr-tools 2.23.3 (npm install --save-exact in app/, platform stamp re-touched; @rotheric/visuals lock entry untouched). swc-loader include gained @941design/marmot (also matches marmot-engine) and @941design/nostr-events. New client/ module implements the signer adapter, SimplePool transport, IndexedDB store+lease open, bootstrapAccountClient (ordered startup, loud TypeError on missing collaborators, fatal-step cleanup), owned FIFO, key-package ensure, teardown. Dev-only __fewTest.groupLibrary hook + recording HistoryBackend and the temporary groups-library-smoke spec prove A1-A3 in a real browser. Library harness twin runs the same hook in node.

verification.typecheck: clean (tsc --noEmit); lint NO_LINT at baseline and now
verification.make_build: exit 0; library present in lazy chunk app/out/_next/static/chunks/349.*.js (contains marmot.group.profile.v1, state.1)
verification.smoke_e2e: groups-library-smoke 3/3 passed on 3 consecutive fresh-relay runs: A3 pass, A1 pass, A2 pass
verification.old_flow_spot_check: groups-lifecycle 5/5 passed (first run flagged INVALID by cold-compile reload, rerun valid and green)
verification.callback_fifo: A real-library harness reproduces a reentrant send during a delayed history append. The scoped queue passes that regression and fake timers verify overlapping callbacks, unrelated progress, rejection and disposal. Pascal accepted the production callback scope wiring. Chromium passed all 21 focused cases with that wiring.

decisions: Adapter factory returns {signer,budget} separately (client takes budget as an option). nsec -> {policy:'none'}; nip07/nip46 -> {concurrency:2,minSpacingMs:200,timeoutMs:120000,leaseMs:150000}.
New adapter takes a structural AppEventSigner, so client/ never imports applesauce-core (goes away with the fork) or NDK.
Key-package ensure and the injected 10050 ensure are non-fatal (reported via onError, recorded in account.ensure); every earlier step is fatal and triggers contract-order cleanup.
lease-held is returned as a value ({status:'lease-held'}); waiting/lease-loss left to S17.
All collaborators (history, client event handlers, inbox handlers, group notification callback, inbox relay list port) are required; omission throws TypeError before anything opens.

Smoke hook is installed from MarmotContext.tsx (outside scope.includes, one effect) through a variable-guarded dev check so the library is bundled in production and make build is a real bundling proof; S27 must remove the effect, hook files and spec.
A2 fork staged by a partitionable transport wrapper (held inbound, timed-out history requests) in testHooks, with both clients admins.
Inbox kinds 21059/21064 defined locally in client/createClient.ts (INBOX_HANDLER_KINDS) until S2 provides AppKinds.
Playwright chromium for the guest HOME was missing; installed into ~/.cache/playwright-few via npx playwright install chromium.
limitations: e2e runs on next dev; the production bundle is proven to compile/bundle/export and contain the library, but is not executed in a browser.
Second half of A3 (own send on an abandoned branch before confirmation is never delivered/withdrawn) not exercised: own sends confirm by publish ack even while partitioned (recorded as VQ-S1-031).

retrospective.harder_than_needed: The story scope listed no place to install the dev-only hook (MarmotContext.tsx/_app.tsx), and the obvious `if (NODE_ENV !== 'production') import(...)` guard is dead-code-eliminated, which would have made the make build bundling proof vacuous; I had to route it through a variable and verify the library chunk exists. Also the guest HOME lacked ~/.cache/playwright-few, so the stated e2e command failed at browser launch until chromium was installed.
retrospective.surprised_by: The first single-spec run of groups-lifecycle after the build was flagged INVALID (cold-compile reload) with no edit; rerun was clean.

lead_notes: 2026-11-17 post-examiner: relay-query.ts gained #h/ids/since filter fields (Fable remediation, smoke-spec scoping); production build tree-shakes the dev hook call site, so make build proves compile+emit only — runtime proof moved to AC-GATE-6 (S29). bootstrap result union also includes unsupported(storage), aborted, signer-timeout.
